Done. All verification commands pass.

## Changes

- **`bridge/acp-tools.mjs`**: intro now tells Muse to end a finished reply with a `[[done]]` line and that a reply with neither a block nor `[[done]]` is unfinished; added `stripDoneMarker()` which strips a trailing `[[done]]` line (tolerates spaces, `**`, case) or returns null.
- **`bin/muse-acp.mjs`**: in `runPrompt`, a block-less reply without `[[done]]` no longer ends the turn — it streams as `agent_thought_chunk` and Muse gets a nudge (counted as a `MUSE_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` round). The second consecutive block-less reply ends the turn with that reply as the final answer (exactly one nudge sent). A reply ending with `[[done]]` is final and the marker is stripped before `agent_message_chunk`. Tool-call replies reset the block-less counter; `[[done]]` is also stripped from thought text and from resumed pending replies, so the marker never reaches BB.
- **Tests**: appended `[[done]]` to scripted final replies in acp-tools (×2), acp-mcp (×2), acp-prompt (new script — 3 prompts, one send each), acp-slots (new script — keeps the parallel test within its 1500 ms budget); added 3 tests covering nudge→tool→done, two block-less replies → 1 nudge → end, and `**[[done]]**` stripping.

Verification:
- `node /tmp/muse-nudge/check.mjs "$PWD"` → `OK`
- `node --test tests/acp-tools.test.mjs tests/acp-mcp.test.mjs tests/acp-prompt.test.mjs tests/acp-slots.test.mjs` → 23 pass, 0 fail
- Neighboring fake-mode tests (acp.test, acp-pending, acp-cancel, acp-skills) still pass unchanged; intro is 7008 bytes worst case (< 8 KB).

APPROACH: `stripDoneMarker` lives next to `parseToolCall` in acp-tools; the loop counts consecutive block-less replies (`MAX_BLOCKLESS_REPLIES = 2`): first one streams as thought + nudge, second ends the turn as the final answer; a tool-call reply resets the counter. Nudge sends count toward `MUSE_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS`.

LESSON: scripted "final" replies in fake-mode tests silently rely on turn-ending semantics — when that semantics changed to require `[[done]]`, any test ending in plain text needed the marker appended (or a script) rather than a behavior workaround.
